title: Topkey + Hostfully Integration: Automate Financial Operations for Short-Term Rental Managers
summary: See how short-term rental managers use the Topkey + Hostfully integration to automate Owner Adjustments, receipts, Bill Pay and accounting sync.
body_markdown:
Hostfully handles bookings, owners and the owner statements it publishes to the Owner Portal. It doesn’t capture spending in the field, pay vendors or turn a one-off charge into an Owner Adjustment. Someone still types each adjustment in by hand from card statements and vendor invoices, and the receipt lives somewhere else.


[Topkey’s Hostfully integration](https://topkey.io/integrations/hostfully) closes that gap. It connects your cards, bills and bank accounts to Hostfully, creates Owner Adjustments with markups applied and a link to the receipt, and pays vendors and owners in bulk. When an owner asks what a charge was for, the answer is one click away.


## Topkey + Hostfully at a Glance


- **What it is:** a direct connection between Topkey and Hostfully, available in the Hostfully Marketplace.
- **What Topkey pulls from Hostfully:** properties, plus bookings and their financial line items.
- **What Topkey sends to Hostfully:** one-time Owner Adjustments with the property, date, name, notes, marked-up amount and a receipt link.
- **What it doesn’t touch:** your owner records, recurring Owner Adjustments and statement templates stay as you set them in Hostfully.
- **Who it’s for:** short-term rental property managers on Hostfully who want less retyping, fewer missed owner billables and faster answers for owners.
- **What else connects:** Breezeway, QuickBooks Online, Xero, Oracle NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Amazon Business and the business cards you already use.


## What Syncs between Topkey and Hostfully


Properties sync from Hostfully on a schedule, and bookings come in for revenue reconciliation in RevHub. Topkey only sends one-time Owner Adjustments, and only when someone on your team sends them.


## Why Hostfully Teams Still Lose Time at Month-End


Hostfully builds owner statements from bookings and the Owner Adjustments you add. Recurring fees are easy to set up once. The one-off charges are the manual part. Someone pulls them from card statements and vendor invoices, works out which property each belongs to, and types each Owner Adjustment into Hostfully.


Then the questions start. An owner opens their statement in the Owner Portal on the 5th and wants to know what a maintenance charge was for. You know it was real, but the proof is somewhere in the card statement, your inbox or a text thread with your handyman.


And some charges never make it at all. When adjustments are entered from memory, small ones get missed. Every charge that never becomes an Owner Adjustment is cash your company covers.


## How the Topkey + Hostfully Integration Works


### Capture Every Expense at the Point of Sale


Connect the business cards you already use, or issue Topkey[corporate cards](https://topkey.io/corporate-cards) . When someone swipes, they get a text with a link to add the receipt, pick the Hostfully property and mark whether the owner pays, right from their phone.


- **AI coding:** Topkey suggests a GL code for each charge.
- **Merchant rules:**[merchant rules](https://topkey.io/academy/how-to-automate-expense-categorization-with-merchant-rules-in-topkey) code repeat vendors with the property, category and Bill to Owner already set.
- **Amazon Business:**[Amazon Business](https://topkey.io/integrations/amazon-business) orders arrive with the order number and receipt.


### Send Owner Adjustments to Hostfully


Your team creates a work order in Topkey from a Bill to Owner card charge or Bill Pay invoice. When it’s sent, Topkey creates one Owner Adjustment in Hostfully with the property, date, amount and notes filled in.


- **Receipt links:** each Owner Adjustment carries a link to the receipt stored in Topkey, so the backup sits right next to the charge.
- **One-time only:** Topkey creates one-time adjustments and leaves your recurring adjustments, owner records and statement templates alone.
- **Approvals first:**[approval workflows](https://topkey.io/features/approval-workflows) put a manager’s sign-off in front of larger expenses, and an Owner Adjustment waits for that approval before Topkey sends it.


### Apply Markups without the Math


Set a markup percentage by vendor or property group, and Topkey applies it before the adjustment leaves. Hostfully receives the marked-up amount, so the owner statement shows a fully priced charge without anyone reaching for a calculator.


### Pay Vendors in Bulk


The handyman still needs to get paid.[Bill Pay](https://topkey.io/bill-pay) reads vendor invoices, codes them to the right Hostfully property and GL account, and routes them through approvals. Pay vendors in bulk by ACH or check, and the same invoice becomes the Owner Adjustment. Nobody pays through Zelle or a bank portal and then types the invoice into Hostfully.


### Pay Every Owner in One Batch


Owner payouts don’t have to mean one transfer at a time. Import owner payout amounts from a CSV or create them in bulk, send them through approval, then select the requests that are Ready To Pay and pay them together by ACH. Owners add or update their bank details through a secure link, so a failed payment is a quick fix.


## Revenue Reconciliation for Hostfully Users


Month-end also means proving every booking was paid.[RevHub](https://topkey.io/revenue-reconciliation) brings in your Hostfully bookings with their line items: rent, cleaning and other fees, taxes, discounts and the expected payout. Inquiries don’t come in, only bookings.


- **Airbnb:** connect Airbnb directly and RevHub splits lump-sum payouts into individual reservations.
- **Stripe:** Stripe payouts are matched to the Hostfully bookings behind them.
- **Vrbo and Booking.com:** upload their payout reports and RevHub matches them too.
- **Exceptions:** underpayments, overpayments and unmatched revenue are flagged during the month, not discovered at close.


## Owner Statements in Hostfully


Hostfully builds and publishes the owner statement. Topkey makes sure the one-off charges that belong on it get there, each with its receipt linked and any markup applied. Most owner questions are really a request for the receipt, and the receipt is already there.


If you’d rather draft statements in Topkey, RevHub can build owner statements from your Hostfully bookings and Topkey expenses. It’s set up per account, so ask your customer success manager.


## Inventory That Reaches the Owner


Linens, paper goods and cleaning supplies leave the closet a few items at a time, and the owner rarely sees a charge for them. With[Inventory Management](https://topkey.io/inventory-management) , your team checks supplies out to a Hostfully property from the Topkey storefront, and stock levels update as they go.


To bill them, add the checkout lines to a work order and select Create and send. Topkey sends one Owner Adjustment to Hostfully, with any markup already in the amount, so the owner sees a single priced line instead of a list of supplies.


## Breezeway, Accounting Software and the Rest of Your Stack


- **Breezeway:**[Breezeway](https://topkey.io/integrations/breezeway) work orders go to Hostfully as Owner Adjustments, with Send to Hostfully and Breezeway updating both systems.
- **Accounting software:** coded transactions sync to[QuickBooks Online](https://topkey.io/integrations/quickbooks-online) ,[Xero](https://topkey.io/integrations/xero) ,[Oracle NetSuite](https://topkey.io/integrations/oracle-netsuite) or[Sage Intacct](https://topkey.io/integrations/sage-intacct) . Hostfully gets the owner side and your books get the company side, from the same charge.
- **Cards:** keep the cards and rewards you already have, and add receipt capture and property coding on top.


## Results Property Managers Are Seeing


Faster answers for owners are the obvious win. The bigger one is billing the charges that used to go missing.


One bookkeeper at a 200+ property management company recovered more than $10,000 in owner expenses they had been missing, in their first few months on Topkey. That company runs a different PMS, but the problem it solved is the same one Hostfully teams have: charges that never make it onto an owner statement.


## How to Set Up the Integration


1. **Connect Hostfully.** Select Topkey in the Hostfully Marketplace, or in Topkey go to Settings, then Integrations, then Hostfully, and click Connect with Hostfully. Sign in to Hostfully and approve access.
2. **Check your properties.** Confirm your Hostfully properties came through before your team starts coding to them.
3. **Set your markup rules.** Add any markup percentages by vendor or property group.
4. **Connect your cards and bank accounts.** Connect the cards you already use or issue Topkey corporate cards, and turn on receipt reminders.
5. **Send a test adjustment.** Mark one charge Bill to Owner, create the work order, send it, and find the Owner Adjustment on that owner’s statement in Hostfully.


Your customer success manager can walk through setup with you.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### What Does the Topkey Hostfully Integration Do?


It connects Topkey to Hostfully from the Hostfully Marketplace or from Topkey’s Integrations page. Properties and bookings come into Topkey, and owner-billable charges go back to Hostfully as Owner Adjustments with a receipt link and any markup applied. Topkey adds corporate cards, Bill Pay, owner payouts, receipt capture, revenue reconciliation and accounting sync in one platform built for short-term rental property managers.


### What Is the Best Expense Management Software for Hostfully?


If you want owner-billable spending to reach Hostfully without retyping, Topkey is built for that job. It combines corporate cards, receipt capture by text, AI coding, Bill Pay, approval workflows and merchant rules, then turns owner-billable charges into Hostfully Owner Adjustments with the receipt linked.


### How Do I Automate Owner Adjustments in Hostfully?


Mark a card charge or vendor invoice as Bill to Owner in Topkey, create the work order and send it. Topkey creates a one-time Owner Adjustment in Hostfully with the property, date, amount, notes and a receipt link. Your recurring adjustments, owner records and statement templates stay as you set them.


### How Does Topkey Handle Markups for Hostfully?


Set a markup percentage by vendor or property group, and Topkey applies it before the adjustment is sent. Hostfully receives the marked-up amount as the Owner Adjustment amount.


### Can Topkey Reconcile Hostfully Bookings and Payouts?


Yes. RevHub brings in your Hostfully bookings with their line items and matches them to Airbnb, Stripe, Vrbo and Booking.com payouts and the deposits that land in your bank. It flags underpayments, overpayments and unmatched revenue during the month.


### Does Topkey Work with Breezeway and Hostfully Together?


Yes. Breezeway work orders go to Hostfully as Owner Adjustments, and Send to Hostfully and Breezeway updates both systems.


### Do I Have to Switch Credit Cards to Use Topkey with Hostfully?


No. Connect the business cards you already use and keep your rewards, or issue Topkey corporate cards. Either way, each charge gets a receipt request by text and a Hostfully property.


## Your Back Office Shouldn’t Be the Bottleneck


Most owner questions are really a request for the receipt. When each Owner Adjustment in Hostfully already links to it, the answer takes a click, and the charges that used to slip through get billed.
